name: North East Mall
summary: Busy mall with department stores, fashion & sports chains, a multiplex & a food court.
demographics: North East Mall primarily serves middle-class families and young professionals from the Dallas-Fort Worth Mid-Cities area, with a trade area encompassing Hurst, Bedford, Euless, and nearby suburbs. The typical visitor demographic includes households with median incomes ranging from $50,000 to $85,000, representing a mix of suburban families, young adults, and Hispanic populations that comprise a significant portion of the Northeast Tarrant County area. Shopping patterns reflect value-conscious consumers seeking mainstream national brands, with peak traffic during weekends and holidays when families visit for both shopping and entertainment purposes.
description: North East Mall is a prominent regional shopping destination located in Hurst, Texas, serving the bustling Dallas-Fort Worth Metroplex. Since its opening, this enclosed regional mall has been a cornerstone of retail activity in the Mid-Cities area, offering shoppers a comprehensive selection of national retailers, dining options, and entertainment venues. The mall features a diverse tenant mix that caters to families and shoppers of all ages, with anchor stores and specialty retailers providing everything from fashion and accessories to electronics and home goods. Its strategic location at 1101 Melbourne Road makes it easily accessible from major highways, drawing visitors from Hurst, Bedford, Euless, and surrounding communities. North East Mall continues to serve as a vital community gathering place where residents can shop, dine, and socialize in a comfortable climate-controlled environment.
